subject: Post-demo: MedHealth security follow-up & vendor questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Harper Lutz <harper.lutz@medhealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo: MedHealth security follow-up & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Hi Harper — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same view: 

1) What we covered: demo of Redwood inference latency/cost controls, routing/fallbacks, and how we isolate customer data on Dedicated/Private deployments. You called out SOC 2 and HIPAA alignment as gating items for procurement.

2) Immediate deliverables (what I'll own):
- Share our SOC 2 Type II summary and vendor-friendly evidence (summary + table of in-scope controls) — attached.
- Kick off your vendor security questionnaire (we received your PDF in the call). Monica will coordinate answers and map to our existing evidence.
- Provide BCP/DR evidence and last DR exercise results (we'll provide the test summary + artifacts).

3) Incident response & notification timelines (high-level):
- Redwood incident triage: initial acknowledgment within 2 hours of detection.
- Confirmed customer-impacting incident: initial notification to affected customers within 72 hours of confirmation; follow-ups with a root-cause and remediation plan as available.
- For customers with HIPAA requirements, we follow the same rapid notification cadence and will work through any contract-specific timelines. Mina will confirm formal language for your legal/security teams.

Action items / owners: 
- Monica: complete vendor questionnaire answers (target: 48 business hours).
- Mina: attach SOC 2 summary + BCP/DR test artifacts; draft official IR timeline language for procurement/legal.
- Harper/procurement: confirm any additional evidence fields or specific certification scopes you need (e.g., encryption-at-rest KMS, segmentation diagrams).

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII-summary.pdf (summary), medhealth_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (your original form)

Thanks — ping me if you want the files uploaded to your secure folder instead of email.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2_TypeII-summary.pdf, medhealth_vendor_questionnaire.pdf

From: Harper Lutz <harper.lutz@medhealth.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medhealth.io>, MedHealth Security <security@medhealth.io>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MedHealth security follow-up & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround on the attachments. A few clarifying questions from our security team: 

- When you say "initial notification within 72 hours of confirmation," can you confirm what constitutes "confirmation" on your side (detection vs validation)? Our legal group asks for explicit language for timelines tied to discovery vs confirmation.
- For HIPAA-covered data (we will have a subset of PHI in some workflows), do you have a documented Business Associate Agreement (we can push that later but want to ensure alignment)?
- Procurement will need an architecture diagram showing network segmentation and where Redwood stores keys (KMS provider). Also can you share the results summary from your most recent BCP/DR exercise (date & scope)?

We prefer evidence via a secure share. I can provide an SFTP link or a pre-authorized Drive folder — whichever works for you.

thanks — Harper
Harper Lutz
Head of InfoSec, MedHealth
harper.lutz@medhealth.io

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Harper Lutz <harper.lutz@medhealth.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MedHealth security follow-up & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Hi Harper — quick answers while Mina drafts the formal language for legal: 

- "Confirmation" on our side = validated incident that we have evidence of unauthorized access or a service compromise that impacts customer data. Detection triggers internal investigation; confirmation is when our incident response team has sufficient evidence (logs/KV cache artifacts/forensic timeline). We agree to capture detection and confirmation timestamps in the incident report so you have both.

- BAA: We do offer a standard Business Associate Agreement addendum for customers processing PHI. It's not a blocker — we'll share the template and flag any fields you typically negotiate.

- BCP/DR exercise summary: last full-scale DR tabletop and failover test was 2025-11-12 (region failover from us-east-1 to us-west-2 for Dedicated pools). Outcome: successful failover under 6 minutes for control-plane state and 98% traffic recovery in 20 minutes; follow-up items were network routing cold-starts (remediated). We'll attach the test summary and anonymized logs.

- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys in AWS KMS and also integrates with external HSMs for Private deployments. We'll include an architecture diagram showing key boundaries.

I'll own the questionnaire answers and aim to return the first pass within 48 business hours (so target: EOD Tue 24 Feb). If you prefer a synchronous QA session for the questionnaire mapping, we can schedule 30 minutes.

Monica
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments planned: BCP-DR-test-results-2025.zip, architecture-segmentation-diagram.png

From: Procurement <procurement@medhealth.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Harper Lutz <harper.lutz@medhealth.io>, MedHealth Security <security@medhealth.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MedHealth security follow-up & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Team — procurement here. Couple of requests so we can move the contract review forward: 

1) Please upload the SOC 2 Type II full report (or redacted report) to a secure share and provide the checksum/hash for the file.
2) We need the BCP/DR exercise report and any runbooks that describe RTO/RPO targets for Dedicated capacity.
3) If there are any third-party penetration test reports within last 12 months, please include those or a summary.

If you can drop these into the Drive link Jonas mentioned or provide an SFTP credential, we can grant the right folks access. Also include any standard contract language you prefer for incident notification thresholds (we'll have our legal team circle back on final wording).

Thanks,
Procurement (on behalf of MedHealth)

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@medhealth.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Harper Lutz <harper.lutz@medhealth.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MedHealth security follow-up & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Hi all — following up with the items procurement requested. I've uploaded the artifacts to the secure Drive folder and included short notes below. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/medhealth-security-folder

Uploaded artifacts (redacted as appropriate):
- SOC2_TypeII-summary.pdf — high-level report summary and Table of In-Scope Controls. Full report available under NDA; we can coordinate a redacted copy for procurement review.
- BCP-DR-test-results-2025.zip — results and test checklist from the 2025-11-12 DR exercise. Inside: failover timeline, playbook excerpts, and remediation log.
- PEN-TEST-2025-summary.pdf — top-level findings and confirmed mitigations. Full engagement report available on request.
- Architecture-segmentation-diagram.png — network boundaries, VPC isolation for Private deployments, KMS boundaries and callout for customer-managed keys.

On incident notification language — suggested paragraph for procurement/legal to consider: "Redwood will notify affected customers of confirmed incidents that materially impact customer data within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation and will provide timely updates as more information becomes available. For incidents involving PHI, Redwood will comply with obligations set forth in the mutually executed Business Associate Agreement and applicable law."

Action items from our side: 
- Share full/redacted SOC2 under NDA — Mina to coordinate (target 2 business days after NDA).
- Deliver completed vendor questionnaire answers — Monica (target: EOD Tue 24 Feb).
- Provide any additional test artifacts or pen test reports on request.

If you want an internal walkthrough, I can join a 30-minute call next week to narrate the DR artifacts and pen-test findings.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2_TypeII-summary.pdf, BCP-DR-test-results-2025.zip, PEN-TEST-2025-summary.pdf, Architecture-segmentation-diagram.png
